frontier.hypothesis: A C-level distinction exists that changes make_regs_eqv's qty_first_reg choice for the 72/75 quantity without moving either register's last-use uid -- e.g. a mode/class difference that makes REGNO_REG_CLASS(new) == NO_REGS or otherwise fails the guard at cse.c:844-857 while leaving the emitted instruction set at 83.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c:842-857 gates the displacement on three clauses, only two of which the ledger has attacked (the EBB-outliving clause and the last-uid inequality). The class/mode clauses `new >= FIRST_PSEUDO_REGISTER || REGNO_REG_CLASS(new) != NO_REGS` have never been examined for this function; a pseudo of a different register class or machine mode for i would take a different branch. On the s49 guard-on-a0 chassis the allocation is already target-exact, so only this operand choice remains.
frontier.next_probe: On the s49 guard-on-a0 chassis (rejected/h1-second-loop-guard-on-a0.c), dump .cse via `pwsh tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_80045294` and read which clause of cse.c:844-857 actually decides the 72/75 displacement; then enumerate ONLY mode/class-changing spellings of i (short/char/pointer-typed induction variable, bitfield-backed counter) that keep build_insns at 83, checking nrefs and the emitted sll operand. Every declaration-order and second-counter-identity spelling is already banked KILLED -- do not re-spell those.

frontier.hypothesis: The one-instruction cost of the guard-on-a0 ref-lift is removable, which would leave a 1-instruction residual (the sll operand) instead of the current 5-score / 84-insn form and give a strictly better fallback chassis than candidate.c's score 2 for future work.
frontier.mechanism: The extra instruction appears because `i = a0` must sit inside the guard's arm to keep the guard's a0 read outside cse's equivalence region; target emits `move $s0,$s2` before the slt and `sll $v1,$s0,4` in the delay slot. If the arm's copy can be made to cross-jump-merge with the loop-2 preamble, or if the guard can read a0 through an expression cse cannot canonicalize while `i = a0` stays in front of it, the count returns to 83 with nrefs 4.
